acceptance_criteria: A deployed container renders the project screen with content, or states plainly that no project-plan source is configured.
A named test holds the honest-empty behaviour.
The full suite and the repository privacy gate pass.

baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_B1_01C_CONTAINER_IMAGE_AND_KUBERNETES_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN) -- the image is built in-cluster and is the unit of deployment, so anything the running service reads must either be in the image or be supplied to it; a path into a developer checkout is neither.
baseline.observed: On the deployment brought up on HOST-A on 2026-09-15, the project screen renders with no content. The service starts cleanly and every other screen works.
baseline.what_exists:
ui2/service/src/main/resources/application.yml, verbatim:

  ui2:
    project-plan:
      # Empty by default: ProjectPlanConfiguration then locates the repository
      # checkout own project/ directory itself (deployment_direction: local
      # validation only for this movement). An operator may point this at a
      # different checkout path explicitly.
      directory: ${UI2_PROJECT_PLAN_DIRECTORY:}

and ui2/service/src/main/java/.../boot/ProjectPlanConfiguration.java:25

  @Value("${ui2.project-plan.directory:}") String configuredDirectory

with its own class comment at line 13:

  * secret files, a missing project-plan source is not a startup failure --

The container image is built from ui2/Containerfile, which copies ui2/ into the
build stage and the resulting jar into the runtime stage. The repository
project/ directory is not copied into either. In a deployed container there is
no checkout to locate, the source resolves to nothing, and the screen has
nothing to render. The route is GET /project-plan
(ui2/service/src/main/java/.../api/ProjectPlanController.java:28).

invariants: No credential, address or host path enters the image or a manifest.
Startup does not begin to fail when the source is absent.
report.merge_gate: The worker opens the pull request and does not merge it.
report.objective: The Administration project screen renders empty in a deployed container, because the data it reads lives in a repository checkout that is not in the image.
output_contract: A SESSION CLOSE on the relay as one NEXUS_SESSION_PACKET.

recommended_reasoning.reason: The cause is located and quoted; the remaining work is one packaging decision and its honest empty case.

requirements: The class comment already says a missing source is not a startup failure. Keep that: the fix is that the absence becomes visible, not that it becomes fatal.
If the chosen option copies repository data into the image, it must be data the repository already publishes, and the pull request says which files and how large.
risks: The quick fix is to mount a host path into the pod, which reintroduces exactly the workstation-filesystem dependency 01C exists to remove.

in: Decide and implement how the deployed service obtains its project-plan data, and say in the pull request body which of the options was chosen and why.

Make the empty case honest: a service that has no project-plan source must say so on the screen and in the response, rather than rendering an empty screen that looks like a project with no content. AGENTS.md prefers an explicit UNKNOWN over an invented certainty, and an empty list is an invented certainty here.
A targeted test that fails if the deployed configuration resolves to no source without the screen saying so.
out: Changing what the project-plan payload contains, or the GET /project-plan contract.
Any change to the job engine, worker or discovery path. Separate movements are live there.
Baking a developer machine path into the image or the manifests.

changed: ui2/Containerfile now uses repository-root context and copies project/ into the runtime image; application.yml defaults to /app/project.
ProjectPlanReader detects all five sources unavailable without changing the GET /project-plan shape.
ProjectPlanPanel renders the unavailable state instead of empty plan cards.
completed: Implemented repository-root image packaging of the five published project-plan JSON sources into /app/project.
Implemented an explicit unavailable-source message in the existing metadata_warnings response member and an unavailable screen state.
Added backend and frontend targeted tests for the honest unavailable-source behavior.

effects.ui: The Project plan screen now states when no project-plan source is available rather than rendering empty plan cards.
